placeholder.deviceIdAccount: optional: the phone to send from

option.wait: until the phone has sent it (up to 60 seconds)
option.startNew: only texts that arrive from now on
option.startLatest: also the last 20 texts already there

tip.account: Create the key in your SMSTunnel dashboard under Apps → Add an app. The phone ID is under Phones, with a Copy button; leave it empty to let SMSTunnel pick one of your phones.
tip.countryCode: Completes numbers written without + or 00. Numbers in international format (+14155550123) need nothing.
tip.send: One text per number. Several numbers in msg.to (comma or new line between them, or an array) get one text each, at most 30.
tip.code: The text must contain the code: 4 to 10 digits standing on their own, such as Your code is 482913.
tip.received: Needs a key allowed to read received texts (Can also read received texts) and syncing turned on in the SMSTunnel app.

status.failed: the phone could not send it

error.noAccount: Choose an SMSTunnel account in this node.
error.noKey: The SMSTunnel account has no API key. Create one in your SMSTunnel dashboard under Apps → Add an app.
error.noText: The text is empty. Put it in msg.payload, or set Text in the node.
error.noRecipient: No number to text. Put it in msg.to, or set To in the node.
error.oneNumber: A sign-in code goes to one number. msg.to has several.
error.tooMany: At most __max__ numbers per message: SMSTunnel sends up to 30 texts a minute. Split the list.
error.stopped: No text went to the __count__ numbers after it.
error.noStatus: This API key can't look up statuses (sms:read), so the node doesn't wait for the phone.
error.inbox: This API key may not read received texts. In your SMSTunnel dashboard, open Apps and choose Allow reading received texts for this app (or create a key with Can also read received texts).
